column1: # The order of reading the environment files: W2C_ENV/W2C_SUB_ENV in a file do not redirect, W2C_ROLE is mandatory on a role's route, a part has no role (the environment file contract «Files and reading order»; ENV54-01/02). The form — README.

column4: W2C_ENV in a loaded file is not applied: /tmp/other.env is not read (there is no B), a journal line without the value, not a refusal
W2C_SUB_ENV in a role's file does not redirect: the file of the unit's subsystem is read, /tmp/x.env — not
the unit has no W2C_ROLE — a start refusal, code 2
the unit's W2C_ROLE is not equal to the command's role — a start refusal, code 2
a part's route: the unit's values and the file W2C_SUB_ENV, there is no role — not a refusal (C02-ENV-PART-99)
a part's route: w2c.env is not read (there is no B), W2C_ROLE is not required
